sentences.japanese: 買い物に行かなければならない。一時間で戻るよ。
sentences.english: I have to go shopping. I'll be back in an hour.

sentences.japanese: 飲み物を俺に頼まないでくれよ。自分で買いにいけばいいだろ。
sentences.english: Stop asking me for a drink! Go get it yourself.

sentences.japanese: 靴が小さすぎるから新しいのを買う必要があるな。
sentences.english: My shoes are too small. I need new ones.

sentences.japanese: あなたがじゃがいもを買うように奇蹟を買うことができないなんて本当に残念だわ。
sentences.english: It's a pity that you can't buy miracles like you would buy potatoes.

sentences.japanese: いつか、綿菓子をつくる機械を買うんだ。
sentences.english: Someday I will buy a cotton candy machine.
